items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Played a little vaudeville, you know, Dusty Best of Fletcher, acts and a chorus line.

ctx.x: Now, how -- what kind of shows were you playing at the Lafayette?
Played a little vaudeville, you know, Dusty Best of Fletcher, acts and a chorus line. I met my wife -- my wife was a chorus girl.
